propositions: Function-scoped rebar_repo fixture dominates tests/interfaces wall-clock by running git init + init_repo per test, making the tier spawn-bound on the macOS Verified gate critical path.
Replace per-test repo build with a session-scoped template built once per xdist worker under tmp_path_factory, then copytree a per-test copy, cutting setup from ~306ms to ~22ms.

Each copy must rewrite worktree pointers (.tickets-tracker/.git and worktrees gitdir) to the realpath template path, because bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op that leaves the copy on the template's object store and refs.

Copies must set REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR per test, re-randomize .env-id/.signing-key via unconditional write (not the idempotency-guarded init._gen_local_files), and reset ensures._pending_cache to close sharing axes.

A tier-wide autouse guard must reject any store whose git worktree list --porcelain paths fall outside its own REBAR_ROOT, and this must use worktree list rather than the green-while-broken --git-common-dir check.
The session template must build inside its own MonkeyPatch context that pins REBAR_ROOT/XDG_CONFIG_HOME and clears tracker env, and must assert it is virgin (no tickets, no .rebar) on branch tickets.
